period_note: Full Balance Sheet + Profit and Loss Account sourced directly from Jamuna Bank's own website unaudited interim financial statement PDF for this quarter (jamunabankbd.com/financial-statements/) -- richer than the annual-report-embedded 'Variance' table used for other quarters in this dataset. Balance sheet is the period-end snapshot (reported); its comparative column is the immediately preceding audited Dec-31 year-end (BDT 142859.17m total assets), not a prior-year-same-quarter figure -- this is the source document's own comparative convention. SOLO / Bank-only section used (labelled plainly "JAMUNA BANK LIMITED" / "BALANCE SHEET (Un-audited)" in the source, the second of two balance sheets in the PDF, after a first "...and its Subsidiaries / Consolidated Balance Sheet" section which is NOT used here), matching this dataset's Solo main series. Income-statement items are the DISCRETE quarter's own figures (not cumulative): the source document itself prints both a cumulative-from-Jan-1 column and a discrete single-quarter column side by side for Q2/Q3 filings ("January to September" vs "July to September"); the discrete column is used here for consistency with the embedded-table-sourced quarters elsewhere in this dataset. Cross-validated against the annual-report-embedded 'Variance' table for the same quarter where both sources exist (net_interest_income, operating_income, operating_expenses and operating_profit matched exactly for every overlapping quarter checked: 2016-2017 Q1-Q3). Foundation contribution (BDT 13.65m, 'Contribution to Foundation@3% pre-tax profit') is folded into 'tax_expense' and 'profit_after_tax' is computed as Total profit before taxes (C-D) minus this combined tax_expense, matching this dataset's annual *_Q4.json convention (no separate foundation line carried there). This source document's own 'Net profit after taxation' line is NOT used directly for profit_after_tax because its position relative to the Foundation-contribution line varies between report vintages -- in some quarters it is already net of the Foundation contribution (matching PBT-Tax-Foundation exactly), in others (confirmed for this bank's own 2018 Q2 and Q3 website interim filings) it is only post-tax and a separate 'Retained earnings' line further down is the true post-Foundation bottom line; computing directly from the three independently-reported components (PBT, tax provision, Foundation contribution) sidesteps this label ambiguity. The reported EPS figure is used as-is (verified to already reflect the post-Foundation profit in every quarter checked).
